hypotheses.hypothesis: Payment's internal charge span shows a sustained failure signature: its five-minute error rate exceeds 0.01 spans per second.
hypotheses.evidence: The recorded snapshot returns about 0.0321 error spans/s at 06:42:00Z and no result at 06:31:23Z.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Frontend server traffic is more than five times its healthy-baseline rate, consistent with a homepage load surge.
hypotheses.evidence: Frontend server traffic is about 63.41 spans/s at 06:42:00Z versus 3.81 spans/s at the healthy-baseline instant.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Checkout PlaceOrder server spans are failing at the same time as payment Charge server spans, so payment is a plausible upstream contributor.
hypotheses.predicts: (sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="checkout", span_name="oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m])) > 0.01) and on() (sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="payment", span_name="oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m])) > 0.01)
hypotheses.evidence: Both server error rates are about 0.0321 spans/s at the incident instant, and the query is empty at baseline. Co-occurrence supports checkout symptoms but cannot alone prove payment caused them.
